title.narrative: Scaling up Azerbaijan's response to HIV involves strengthening national capacities, prioritizing prevention and treatment for high-risk groups, and ensuring quality MDR/XDR TB services remain accessible - Azerbaijan (01-Jul-2024-30-Jun-2027)

description.narrative: Azerbaijan, TB/HIV, Ministry of Health of the Republic of Azerbaijan (MOH Azerbaijan)This program has the following goals: To ensure efficient and sustainable public health control over the HIV and TB epidemics in Azerbaijan. The objectives of this program are: To improve HIV prevention and HIV case finding among KPs using the most up to date approaches and technologies. To substantially increase ART coverage of PLHIV and transit the vast┬ámajority of patients to DTG-based regimens. To sustain universal access to quality and people-centered DS and DR-TB diagnosis, treatment, prevention and M&E. To ensure the necessary community, rights, budgetary and regulatory environment to sustain HIV and TB responses, enabling maximum integration and efficiencies, and prepare for full transition of the programs to the governmental funding
